title: Symmetry of fractional Neumann eigenfunctions in the ball
summary: We investigate symmetry properties of the first nontrivial eigenfunctions of the fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^s$, where $s \in (0,1)$, in an $N$-dimensional ball with nonlocal Neumann boundary conditions. By means of a spectral stability result, we prove that, when $s$ is sufficiently close to $1$, the eigenspace associated to the first nontrivial eigenvalue is generated by $N$ antisymmetric eigenfunctions with exactly two nodal domains in the ball.
